correctness.rationale: Exact shortest-Hamiltonian-path weights imply Y union Z with W their skeletal intersection at every mixed threshold. A pair of simplicial retractions splits \(H_{t-1}\)(W)->\(H_{t-1}\)(Y); Mayer–Vietoris computes torsion-free homology rank b_t. For \(t\ge3\) connectivity and Hurewicz–Whitehead prove the integral sphere wedge, and \(t=2\) reduces to uv parallel cross edges. Homology generators from Y die in the next complete skeleton, giving the barcode maps over every field; endpoint cases checked including \(t=N-1\). Independent stdlib Held–Karp and GF2 reduction tests match all barcode multiplicities in 48 examples, but finite tests are not the uniform proof.

value.rationale: This is a full homotopy and all-field barcode classification for a canonical metric family where traditional ℓ∞ Vietoris–Rips persistence is acyclic in positive dimensions. The result isolates high-dimensional ephemeral homology in a new generalized Rips construction at arbitrary finite size, and supplies explicit all-degree lifetimes; the separation hypothesis is used essentially to divide the filtration into pure and mixed regimes.
